deploybot: Deploy pipeline started · env=preprod · target=canary · commit=abc123def · tag=release/0.9.3

deploybot: stages: checkout → install → build → lint → test → deploy

elaine: lint failed on the canary build, flagging here.

deploybot: Lint stage failed: eslint error (CI image node:18-slim-upstream)
```
packages/runtime/kv_cache.ts:12:5 - error  'forEach' is restricted by no-restricted-syntax
  10 | export function primeKV(...) {
  11 |   // prefill cache
> 12 |   arr.forEach((x) => cache.set(x.key, x.val))
     |     ^
  13 | }
```

sam: hmm that's odd — no recent changes to that file in this PR. Could be a CI image bump or eslint rule update baked into the base image.

jia: I saw the CI image was updated in infra-images yesterday (node:18-slim-upstream -> inherits eslint 8.20). I can investigate but may need a quick workaround.

mohit: prefer not to change app code just to appease linter. Options: rerun with previous CI image, pin eslint in CI container, or small hotfix to code. Given change window tonight at 22:00 UTC, we should pick safe path.

elaine: Canary is paused. We need a decision: react with :one: to pin eslint in CI, :two: to cherry-pick hotfix, or :three: to rerun with legacy image (node:18-legacy).

deploybot: reactions tracked: :one: :two: :three: (please add one).

sam: :two: (lean hotfix if it's trivial)

jia: :three: (I can trigger rerun with legacy image quickly)

mohit: :one: (pinning safer for whole org)

elaine: quick prefer :three: to avoid code churn. If it passes, we can follow with a postmortem and decide whether to pin infra image. I will trigger the rerun with node:18-legacy in 5m.

elaine: Triggered rerun with CI_IMAGE=node:18-legacy · build id=ci-1189-retry1

deploybot: Rerun started (ci-1189-retry1) · lint stage now running

deploybot: Lint passed on rerun. Proceeding to test stage.

deploybot: Unit tests passed. Starting integration suite.

deploybot: Integration failure: timeout in test 'model-inference-smoke' (infra-mock).
```
FAIL packages/integration/tests/smoke/model-inference-smoke.test.ts (5m 2s)
  ● model-inference-smoke › completes within timeout

    Timeout - Async callback was not invoked within timeout specified by jest.setTimeout.
      at node_modules/jest-jasmine2/build/queueRunner.js:53:21
```

sam: that integration sometimes flakes; it hit the 5m timeout. Recent infra mocks have been slower due to kv-cache warmups.

mohit: propose increase jest timeout for that test to 8m and rerun, non-blocking. I don't want to rollback the canary for this.

jia: agree. I'll open a tiny change and push it as commit def456 -> ci: bump timeout for model-inference-smoke to 480000ms

deploybot: New commit def456 pushed to canary test-runner config. Re-run triggered (ci-1189-retry2).

deploybot: Integration suite passed on retry. Canary deploy resumed.

deploybot: Canary deploy finished · env=preprod · target=canary · commit=abc123def · status=SUCCESS · duration=22m

elaine: Good job team. We'll add a short release note: "Canary deploys for 0.9.3 resumed after CI image compatibility rerun; flaky integration timeout addressed by increasing test timeout."

mohit: filing follow-up: investigate why kv-cache warmup affects mock infra timing; consider caching tweak.

jia: noted — I'll schedule a quick runbook + follow-up PR.

sam: marking this release as safe to promote after monitoring window. Thx all :tada:

deploybot: Post-deploy summary uploaded to release-notes channel and canned Slack notifications scheduled for the change window at 22:00 UTC.
